items.title: Corporate Training Programs
items.body: Training programs specifically designed for company needs, including leadership training, project management, communications, and team development.

items.title: In-house training
items.body: Training sessions tailored to an organization's specific needs, held at the client's location.

items.title: Workshops & seminars
items.body: Interactive sessions that focus on current topics, such as digital transformation, mental health, and thinking skills.

items.title: Professional Development Courses
items.body: Courses designed to help individuals improve their professional skills in areas such as working excellence, self management, selling skills and communication skills.

items.title: Certification Programs
items.body: Internationally recognized certification programs to increase credibility and competitiveness in the job market such as Human Excellence Specialist, Human Excellence Coach, and Certified Life Coach from Rumah Manusia.

items.title: Career Coaching
items.body: Coaching services that support individuals in planning and achieving their career goals.
